objective: Construct a costed native collective readout or source-valid feedback mechanism, not more fixed-axis experiments.

input_access.supplied: m independent native phase qubits, IID public labels A over Z_(2^L), one uniform independent hidden vector s

local_result: At exact entropy width, source-mean collective PGM lower bound exceeds the fixed-order once-per-qubit adaptive POVM upper bound in the certified growing regimes.
counterpressure: The adaptive upper bound becomes vacuous with two surplus qubits. The native +16 target, label/outcome-adaptive order, revisits, quantum memory and collective primitives remain open.

proof_obligations.PO-REVIEW: Independently review refinement, causal Fourier cancellation, dyadic alias and pairwise fiber moments; code crosschecks are not theorem review.
proof_obligations.PO-SOURCE: Track input counts and the exact joint native law through ordering, sample selection and feedback; do not silently grant duplicate packets.
proof_obligations.PO-CONSTRUCTIVE: Supply uniform polynomial-bit circuits, memory and gate precision. An existence PGM, full fiber table or optimal exhaustive record decoder is not such a circuit.
proof_obligations.PO-NATURAL-REDUCTION: Compose state supply, secret source, noise, input counts and precision with an independently verified natural-problem reduction.
proof_obligations.PO-CLASSICAL: Use identical supplied-state/public-data models. Classically simulating known-secret calibration does not solve unknown-secret recovery; compare with legal measured-data attacks and known quantum algorithms.
proof_obligations.PO-SCOPE: Do not extrapolate an entropy-width source-mean gap to speedup, typical-label success, +16 samples, all LOCC, or fixed secrets.

experiments_with_falsifiers.experiment: Independent review and complete native bounded instrument/fiber censuses.
experiments_with_falsifiers.falsifier: An allowed tree exceeds the common envelope, latest-linear cancellation fails, or exact target moments disagree.

experiments_with_falsifiers.experiment: Sharpen the feedback bound at native +16 without imposing false independence on earlier odd characters.
experiments_with_falsifiers.falsifier: The improved bound remains vacuous, omits feedback terms, or assumes label-adaptive order preserves the fixed physical-frequency source.

experiments_with_falsifiers.experiment: Construct source-valid collective/quantum-memory or adaptive-order inference with costed fresh-state use.
experiments_with_falsifiers.falsifier: It enumerates secrets/fibers, uses copies or chosen labels, consumes a superpolynomial batch, or the legal classical baseline matches it.
